papers.method: PLD 外延；面内异常霍尔与质子栅控
papers.conclusion: 三明治氧化物界面的对称性设计使面内异常霍尔响应可见，离子液体正负栅压还能开关信号。最强证据是外延结构、磁化和霍尔曲线共同变化；但质子进入 CaRuO₃ 也改变载流子与局域化学环境，不能把栅压效应称为纯静电或把“对称性”认作唯一因果变量。

sections.title: 问题—样品—生长
sections.text: 公开作者稿实际给出 NdGaO₃(110)ₒ 基底上 CaRuO₃(t)/La₂/₃Ca₁/₃MnO₃(32 个晶胞)/CaRuO₃(t)；NdGaO₃ 先在 1000 °C 退火 4 h。KrF 248 nm PLD，700 °C，1.8 J/cm²；CaRuO₃ 的 O₂ 为 7.5 Pa，La₂/₃Ca₁/₃MnO₃ 为 30 Pa；原位退火 15 min、2000 Pa O₂ 中冷却。靶材配比与纯度、各样品 t 的完整厚度表、每炉产率在已读 Methods 未报告。

sections.title: 质量—测量—证据
sections.text: RHEED、XRD/RSM 与截面 STEM 支撑层状外延；VSM/SQUID 给出磁化，六端 Hall bar 在 PPMS ±7 T 测霍尔。作者报告磁有序温度至少约 250 K、矫顽场约 200 Oe。离子液体 DEME-TFSI 用 Keithley 2450 施加 +1.4 V/−1.0 V，质子化/去质子化切换面内异常霍尔。直接观察是结构和 Hall 曲线改变；DFT+U+SOC（U=8 eV、J=2 eV）的轨道图像属模型解释。需排除栅控中的漏电、热历史和氧空位迁移。

sections.title: 复现路径
sections.text: 下一批固定 La₂/₃Ca₁/₃MnO₃ 为 32 u.c.，仅改变上下 CaRuO₃ 厚度和栅控历史；同器件记录栅流、Hall 前后 XRD/RSM、XPS 或深度氢证据，以区分质子反应与电场。结构证明界面对称性受到设计，但本图景本身不能证明所有电荷输运来自单一界面。

sections.title: 最强证据与可检验的替代机制
sections.text: 这项工作的核心实验不是仅仅“看到了 Hall”。若结构对称性设计正确，面内磁化方向、外延方位和横向电压的奇偶关系应同时符合晶体对称性约束。作者把这种几何选择与层状 STEM/RSM、磁化及 Hall 对照组合，是比单条横电压曲线更强的证据。但离子液体栅压可能导致 H⁺ 进入 CaRuO₃，带来价态、氧含量、应变和散射率同时改变；这些变量中任何一个都可能改变 AHE 振幅。最直接的判别是同一器件重复可逆栅压循环，并把栅压积分电荷与截面 H/O 谱、RSM 变化并列；如恢复电压后结构不完全恢复，不能称纯电场可逆开关。

sections.title: 样品台账与误差预算
sections.text: 复现时应为每个 t 值保存 PLD 激光脉冲数、RHEED 振荡次数、基底退火批次、氧压历史和 Hall bar 实际宽度。Hall 曲线须保留原始 Vxy(+H) 与 Vxy(−H)，分开计算纵向电压串扰、普通霍尔斜率和磁滞剩余项。仅在高场线性区拟合普通 Hall 时，是否完全饱和需要磁化同温检验；否则“减掉的线性背景”也可能包含未饱和反常项。图 1–5 中纵轴单位、磁场方向和温度都应逐个对齐，避免将不同厚度器件比较误读为同样载流子密度。

sections.title: 从下一炉到下一次 Hall 的操作清单
sections.text: 第一步用同一片 NGO(110)ₒ 基底批次和相同 RHEED/PLD 标定沉积一个上下 CRO 对称、一个只改上 CRO 厚度、一个上下互换的矩阵。所有 LCMO 中层保持 32 u.c.，并用截面 STEM 的多个位置确认层厚，不用单个漂亮视野代表整片。第二步把每个器件的未栅控 Hall、M(H)、纵向电阻和温度扫描按同一坐标系统归档，特别保留霍尔电压反磁场原始支路。第三步做 DEME-TFSI +1.4 V 与 −1.0 V 循环时连续记录栅流及栅压保持时间，限制不可逆电化学漂移；每轮后立即复测普通 Hall 斜率与 AHE 形状。第四步用独立结构和化学探针检查质子/氧空位是否回到原态。若 AHE 开关而普通 Hall、磁化、结构也全部变化，就要定量分解贡献，不能只挑支持镜面对称性的证据。反之，如果微小结构变化伴随严格的对称选择规则而与载流子数不相关，才更强地支持作者提出的界面机制。

papers.title: Bandwidth-Limited Critical Currents in Electrically Tunable Moiré Bands
papers.authors: Riccardo Bertini; Xueqiao Wang; Sergey Slizovskiy; Zhiren Isaac Zheng; Julien Barrier; Chiara Pizzo; Robin Smeyers; Krystian Nowakowski; Hitesh Agarwal; Álvaro Moreno; Bert Jorissen; Kenji Watanabe; Takashi Taniguchi; Milorad V. papers.method: 双栅调带宽；高电流四探针输运
papers.abstract:
Abstract 
                   Moiré superlattices host narrow minibands whose bandwidth governs correlated and topological phases. Here, we demonstrate that the bandwidth also sets the critical current for the onset of out-of-equilibrium transport. In bilayer graphene aligned to hexagonal boron nitride, we explore the high-current transport regime as we continuously flatten the valence miniband using an out-of-plane displacement field. We observe a significant reduction in the critical current, which is captured by a minimal analytical model and corresponds to the calculated narrowing of the miniband. Moreover, by comparing distinct moiré platforms, we show that the scaling between critical current and bandwidth is a universal feature of graphene superlattices. Our results reveal a direct link between miniband dispersion and high-current transport, and establish this regime as a fast and accessible electrical probe of bandwidth evolution.
papers.conclusion: 高偏流下出现的临界电流随着垂直位移场使价带窄化而降低。四个器件与带宽模型把莫尔色散和非平衡输运连接起来；临界电流—带宽对应是解释，不是直接量到的能带宽度，接触加热和局部非均匀性仍是复现实验需要单独检查的项。

sections.title: 器件与调控
sections.text: 公开作者稿描述四个双层石墨烯/hBN 器件：上 hBN 对准石墨烯，下 hBN 故意错配，石墨顶/底栅独立调密度和位移场，莫尔周期约 13 nm。石墨烯母片来源、转移时温湿度、接触电阻分布、器件批次良率在已读主文未完整报告。

sections.title: 关键曲线与解释
sections.text: 四探针 R 与 dV/dI 在 n/n₀≈−0.5 处比较；D 从 0 增至约 0.4 V/nm，价带平坦化同时临界电流下降。直接测量为电阻和阈值；紧束缚带宽及其与阈值的对应是模型拟合。作者讨论阈值前自热对 dV/dI 的影响小于约 10%，仍需用脉冲宽度和温度测量验证无局部热点。

sections.title: 下一次测量
sections.text: 对同一器件在相同载流子密度下做 D 往返扫描，测临界电流的滞后、接触区温度代理与不同脉冲占空比，再以独立量子振荡或光谱约束带宽。图解仅说明现有数值窗口，不能把有限器件推成普适定律。

sections.title: 阈值定义与模型前提
sections.text: 临界电流来自高偏流 dV/dI 曲线中非平衡响应开始偏离低流区的点；它并不等价于超导临界电流。四个器件即使莫尔周期相近，扭角误差、无序和接触电阻也可能造成阈值分散。理论上，把位移场 D 与价带宽度 W 建立单调关系需要固定 hBN 配准、屏蔽、局部填充和器件几何；图中 W 是模型计算量，不是这次直接用 ARPES 测出的值。最稳妥的比较是同器件在 n/n₀=-0.5 固定填充下往返扫 D，再与另一填充和导带区作为内部对照。

sections.title: 加热、归一化与重复性
sections.text: 高电流下 Joule 热可能先把电阻推高，尤其莫尔窄带的电子温度可与晶格温度分离。作者讨论阈值前的估算小于约 10%，但仍应报告 DC 与短脉冲阈值、脉冲占空比、热沉温度、不同电极的电压分布。跨器件比较临界电流应至少同时呈现电流密度或每单位宽度的值以及填充和 D，不能只比较总电流。公开原始 dV/dI 曲线和阈值算法，才能使“带宽限制”与接触触发机制被后续研究者区分。

papers.method: 生长时分层调氧化剂暴露；铁电极化
papers.abstract:
Abstract 
                   HfO2-based ferroelectrics are promising for scalable memories, neuromorphic systems, and flexible electronics, but their performance is governed by oxygen vacancies that affect phase stability, leakage, wake-up behavior, and domain switching. Existing strategies mainly focus on tuning the overall oxygen-vacancy concentration, making it difficult to balance polarization and stability, especially in flexible devices where the low thermal budget and mechanically compliant stack complicate vacancy distribution and interfacial reactions. Here, we develop a growth-compatible spatial oxygen-vacancy engineering strategy by adjusting oxidant exposure during Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 (HZO) film growth. This method regulates the bottom-interface, bulk, and top-interface oxygen environments without post-treatment. Depth-resolved defect analyses verify position-selective regulation of the oxygen environment and reveal the depth-dependent effects of oxygen vacancies. Reducing oxygen vacancies near the top interface improves reversible polarization switching, whereas excessive oxygen regulation in the bulk or bottom-interface region weakens the ferroelectric response. The top-enhanced device achieves the highest remanent polarization of 31.82 μC cm–2, 41.0% higher than that of the bottom-enhanced device, and exhibits the weakest wake-up effect and the smallest long-term fatigue degradation after 1010 cycles. This work reveals the influence and underlying mechanism of spatial oxygen-vacancy distribution on HZO ferroelectricity, providing a practical design principle for high-performance HfO2-based ferroelectric devices.
papers.conclusion: 论文摘要指出上界面降低氧空位有利可逆极化，并报告剩余极化 31.82 μC/cm²、比底界面增强方案高 41%。位置选择性控制比“总空位越少越好”更有实验价值；但当前仅能确认摘要，不能把极化变化唯一归因于氧空位分布。

papers.method: 氧介导轨道杂化；各向异性磁阻
papers.abstract:
Abstract 
                   Spin state manipulation in anisotropy magnetoresistance (AMR) materials is key to improving their transport property for constructing highly sensitive and direction-resolvable magnetic sensors. Currently, the mainstream strategy of tuning the transport property focuses on the modulation of charge by controlling the physical scattering path of conduction electrons, limiting the AMR ratio below 4% and linear sensitivity lower than 1.5%/Oe. This paper reports a strategy of manipulating the orbital degree of freedom to achieve an unprecedently large AMR effect. Here, we achieved the oxygen tunability of the spin state in a highly textured MgO/NiFe/MgO/Ta multilayer by regulating the Fe–O orbital hybridization in the lattice-texture-tunable coordination environment. The (111)- and (110)-textured films exhibit a low-spin state, offering enough unoccupied d↑ states to enhance the s–d↑ scattering and improve the transport property. On this basis, a considerable AMR ratio of 8.7% and a high linear sensitivity of 2.7%/Oe were achieved, helping to construct an ultrasensitive sensor with sensitivity approaching 3.3 mV/V/Oe, which is the highest value among the commercialized AMR sensors. These results provide a feasible idea for developing the orbital-modulated AMR sensor and clarify the physical origin of magneto-ion-spin coupling.
papers.conclusion: 摘要报告 (111)/(110) 织构与 Fe–O 杂化相关的 AMR 增强，最高 8.7%、线性灵敏度 2.7%/Oe。器件响应值得跟踪；“低自旋态导致增强”是作者模型推断，尚需排除普通氧化引起的电流路径和界面散射变化。

sections.text: 层序 MgO/NiFe/MgO/Ta 已知；层厚、沉积温度、氧分压、织构占比、粗糙度、退火与 Fe 价态光谱：正文未报告（摘要级）。仅凭 (111)/(110) 织构名义不等于每个界面都同质。

papers.authors: Aoxuan Wang; Haoran Li; Zhibin Xu; Hao Chen; Xiaofan Lv; Yumeng Zhao; Dehua Xu; Zhenglin Hu; Qingtao Ma; Xingjiang Liu; Jiayan Luo
papers.institutions: 主要单位以正式论文署名为准

papers.method: 导电聚合物支架耦合拉伸应变与外延沉积
papers.abstract:
Abstract 
                   Lithium metal is considered as the ultimate anode for high-energy-density batteries, yet its practical realization is thwarted by dendrite proliferation and chemomechanical interfacial instability. While epitaxial growth on crystallographically textured substrates provides a template for ordered deposition, sustaining this ordered growth under high capacities and current densities remains a formidable kinetic challenge. Herein, we overcome this barrier by engineering an elastic (110)-oriented lithium anode (e-Li (110)) comprising a conductive polymer scaffold. The e-Li (110) integrates preferred (110) crystallographic orientation with a mechanically coupled strain corresponding to the optimized 4% tensile-strain condition. Consequently, this strain-engineering strategy enables a capacity of 30 mAh cm–2 and current density of 25 mA cm–2 before lithium epitaxial breakdown. 5.9 Ah Li || LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 (NCM811) pouch cells with a high energy density of 509.8 Wh kg–1 show 90% capacity retention after 140 cycles. In sulfide-based all-solid-state batteries (ASSBs), e-Li (110) anode enables stable cycling for over 1600 cycles at a rate of 5 C. By highlighting strain as a critical parameter, our work provides a strategy for mechano-electrochemical coupling in lithium metal anodes for high-rate, high-energy-density batteries.
papers.conclusion: 这是生长动力学邻近领域：摘要声称 4% 拉伸应变的 (110) Li 阳极在 25 mA/cm² 可沉积至 30 mAh/cm² 才失去外延，5.9 Ah 软包电池达到 509.8 Wh/kg。电池性能不能反推晶体外延无缺陷，需分别核晶向和界面稳定证据。

sections.title: 范围与已知数值
sections.text: 材料偏向电化学储能，列在晶体生长板块是因其取向/应变控制沉积形貌；导电聚合物成分、Li 基底制备、应变测量方法、原位衍射与循环参数：正文未报告（摘要级）。

papers.title: Strong metamagnetic switching and anisotropic magnetotransport in the distorted kagome magnet Tb6Ti4Al43
papers.authors: Lipika; Sneh; Shobha Singh; Ralf Koban; Walter Schnelle; Rie Umetsu; Kaustuv Manna
papers.institutions: 完整作者见 arXiv；单位以正文署名为准
papers.journal: arXiv:2610.06732（10 月 6 日官方列表）
papers.access: 全文精读：公开作者稿 主文、Methods、图 1–5 及图注；未实际打开的 SI 不计入。
papers.method: Al 助熔剂；磁化/比热与磁矩各向异性
papers.abstract: We report a comprehensive investigation of the magnetic, electrical, and thermodynamic properties of single crystalline Tb6Ti4Al43, in which Tb atoms form a distorted kagome lattice embedded within a complex Ti-Al framework. Tb6Ti4Al43 exhibits pronounced magnetic anisotropy and antiferromagnetic ordering at approximately 19 K. For magnetic field applied along the c-axis, a strong metamagnetic switching is observed, accompanied by a clear asymmetric hysteresis at low temperatures, while for field applied along the ab plane, a spin-flop transition is observed. The effect of field induced magnetic states is strongly reflected in magnetotransport measurements, giving rise to pronounced anomalies in magnetoresistance and an anomalous Hall contribution. A significant intrinsic contribution to the anomalous Hall conductivity is observed, highlighting the Berry curvature effects arising from the system's momentum-space topology. Our results highlight the interplay of spin, charge, and lattice degrees of freedom in Tb6Ti4Al43 and establish this distorted kagome antiferromagnet as a promising platform for field-tunable multifunctional behaviour, including electrically readable magnetic switching, spin manipulation, and magneto-mechanical functionalities.
papers.conclusion: 作者用明确的 Al flux 温程生长毫米级单晶，并把 19 K 反铁磁序、约 1 T 沿 c 轴的变磁转变连到结构/热容。最值得复现的是 40:3:1000→1000 °C→2 °C/h→750 °C 的流程；磁力矩会使样品在磁场中旋转，未夹紧的“各向异性”可能混入机械伪影。

sections.title: 配方与质量
sections.text: Tb/Ti/Al 均 99.99%，名义 40:3:1000，约 3 g 装氧化铝坩埚，Ar 手套箱内封真空石英；100 °C/h 升至 1000 °C 保温 24 h，2 °C/h 降至 750 °C 后离心，获 1–2 mm 银色晶体。EDS 近 6:4:43、Laue/高分辨 XRD 支持 P6₃/mcm，a=b≈11.03 Å、c≈17.7 Å；多炉产率和 EDS 统计误差未完整报告。

sections.title: 温场、模型与风险
sections.text: 磁化/比热约 19 K 有序，2 K H∥c 在约 ±1 T 呈磁滞变磁，ab 难轴至 7 T 仍未饱和。比热 >80 K 用 Debye+Einstein 拟合，θD=484.2 K、θE=124.7 K、γ≈146 mJ/mol K²，约 19 K 的熵接近 6Rln3；这些是拟合/积分，不直接决定微观自旋排布。作者用石英杆夹持避免扭矩引起转动，值得纳入每次测量记录。

sections.title: 下一炉与下一测量
sections.text: 复制 40:3:1000 并围绕 Al/Tb 微调两档，记录离心残余 flux 和每炉产率；在同一晶片做三正交方向角分辨磁化与转矩，夹持前后重复以量化装夹伪影。

sections.title: 图 5–8 的证据阶梯
sections.text: 图 5 中小场 ZFC/FCW 至约 0.3 T 基本重合，而约 0.5 T 以下 10 K 开始分叉；约 0.7 T 出现阶跃，超过 1 T 有序峰弱化。比热峰随场向低温移动给出与磁化独立的热力学信号，强于单独的磁滞解释。图 6 采用约 9 Oe、93 Hz 的交流磁场，3 kOe 偏置下变频峰位移动提示慢弛豫，但峰移本身不能判定典型自旋玻璃，需要看 Mydosh 参数、Arrhenius/Vogel-Fulcher 拟合窗口及频率跨度。图 7 的纵向/横向磁阻在变磁处同步突变，是自旋散射改变的支持证据；但接触受扭矩影响，故必须报告装夹、接触电阻和重复扫场。

sections.title: 霍尔数据处理不能机械反对称化
sections.text: 作者在图 8 特别保留 2–3 K 磁滞区原始横向电阻：把 +H 与 −H 两条不同历史路径直接做 [ρyx(H)−ρyx(−H)]/2 会人为抹掉真正的不可逆霍尔信息。只在高场可逆区及 7–20 K 区间使用反对称化以去纵向混入。这条处理规则对研究生工作平台极重要：原始正/反扫必须分层保存，导出的 Hall 系数要注明扫场支路、拟合场窗和是否反对称化。图 8 的 ρyx=R₀H+RSM 属拟合分解，R₀ 也可能受到多带和异常项非饱和影响，不应把拟合残差直接命名“拓扑霍尔”。

sections.title: 同一块晶体的纵横向输运对照
sections.text: 图 7 对 ρzz(H) 与 ρxx(H) 采用不同电流/电压几何，H 均沿 z，2 K 变磁后电阻率的陡降可与自旋无序散射减少一致；高场重新上升的正磁阻则表示电子轨道/多带背景尚在。横向曲线的峰更突出不必立即解释成新的相，它也可能来自电流路径、几何因子或接触在大转矩下轻微移动。作者明确提到 H 在 ab 面时样品甚至会旋转并弄断接点，因此最可靠的复现是先拍照记录电极坐标、四端接点宽度与夹持位置，再在磁场循环前后量零场接触电阻。比较两种几何前要以 Laue 轴向和实际尺寸计算电阻率，不能直接比较电阻欧姆数。比热、磁化、交流磁化率、霍尔与纵横磁阻全部绑定同一母晶编号，才能判断各个 0.5–1 T 异常是否来自同一相界。

readingGuide.focus: 核 θD/θE/γ 的拟合区间、熵背景与石英杆装夹；一般稀土磁性背景可略。
readingGuide.next: 做配比小矩阵并将夹持前后各向异性差异入样品日志。

papers.title: Structural, electronic, and magnetic properties of HoCo_2 thin films grown by pulsed laser deposition
papers.authors: Ajay Kumar; Christopher Burgio; Anis Biswas; Yaroslav Mudryk
papers.institutions: 完整作者见 arXiv；单位以正文署名为准
papers.journal: arXiv:2610.06655（10 月 6 日官方列表）
papers.access: 全文精读：公开作者稿 主文、Experimental/Methods、图 1–4；未实际打开的 SI 不计入。
papers.method: 800 °C PLD；薄膜结构和磁性
papers.abstract: We report the growth and physical properties of HoCo$_2$ thin films on Si substrate by pulsed laser deposition. Well-defined Kiessig fringes in the x-ray reflectivity data yield a film thickness of $35 \pm 1$~nm and demonstrate smooth film surface and interface profiles. Atomic force microscopy confirms the high morphological quality of the films, revealing subnanometer surface roughness of $\sim$170~pm. Two independently prepared films exhibit a reproducible ferrimagnetic transition at $T_{\mathrm{C}}=77\pm3$~K, demonstrating retention of the characteristic magnetic ordering of bulk HoCo$_2$. However, the absence of resolvable thermal hysteresis indicates a predominantly continuous, second-order like transition in the films, in contrast to the first-order transition of bulk HoCo$_2$. At 5~K, the films exhibit clear magnetic hysteresis with a coercive field of $\sim$600~Oe, substantially larger than the negligible coercivity of bulk HoCo$_2$. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy reveals comparable Ho $4d$ and Co $2p$ core-level line shapes and broadly similar valence-band spectra for the bulk and film, indicating preservation of the essential local electronic environment and occupied electronic structure.
papers.conclusion: 相同靶材经 PLD 成约 35–37 nm 的 HoCo₂ 薄膜，77 K 附近出现磁有序而不见体块靶材约 1 K 宽的热滞后。35.3/64.7 的薄膜 Ho/Co 偏离理想化学计量、只看见一个薄膜 GI-XRD 峰，所以“有序温度改变源自薄膜维度”尚未排除成分和氧的作用。

sections.title: 生长链
sections.text: 约 25 g HoCo₂ 靶由电弧熔炼制成 20 mm 圆片。天然氧化 Si(100) 5×5×1 mm，丙酮/甲醇各超声 10 min、碳胶固定；PLD 基底 800 °C、UHV 约 5×10⁻⁹ Torr、KrF 248 nm、50,000 脉冲、10 Hz、约 3 J/cm²，靶距 5.5 cm。制备两片同条件膜；每脉冲实际生长速率与氧含量未直接给出。

sections.title: 质量与磁化
sections.text: 靶材 XRD 为 C15/Fd-3m，a≈7.1813 Å、EDS Ho33.9/Co66.1；膜 XRR 给 37±2 nm 或布拉格拟合 35±1 nm、1 μm² AFM RMS≈170 pm。薄膜 EDS Ho35.3/Co64.7；GI-XRD 在 2θ=50.75° 的 (400) 单峰不足以独立证明全膜相纯。两膜 TC≈77 K、5 K Hc≈600 Oe；50–60 K 弱异常可能是 SQUID 氧冻结，不能宣称新相。

sections.title: 下一炉
sections.text: 在相同脉冲数做三种基底温度，保留靶材前后 EDS 与薄膜氧深度谱；同片温变 GI-XRD/XRR 和磁化，同时用空基底/空胶测量排除氧冻结背景。

sections.title: 薄膜“质量好”与“相纯”的区别
sections.text: 图 2 的 Kiessig 振荡和 1 μm² AFM RMS≈170 pm 说明表面/界面平整，XRR 的 35±1 与 37±2 nm 是不同数学提取方法下相容的厚度。GI-XRD 以 0.1° 入射只分辨 2θ≈50.75° 一条 HoCo₂(400) 反射，能说明薄膜存在对应晶相贡献，但不能给出完整空间群精修、择优取向体积分数或排除纳米尺度副相。实际 EDS 35.3 at.% Ho 比理想 33.3 at.% 高约 2 个百分点，考虑 EDS 定量误差之后是否显著，应报告重复点、标准样品和膜厚/基底校正。XPS 的 Ho 4d 和 Co 2p 主峰与体块谱形相似也主要反映表面化学，不能替代厚度方向价态剖面。

sections.title: 磁测量的背景和因果
sections.text: 两片相同条件薄膜在 1 kOe χ(T) 都给约 77 K 的特征，dχ/dT 提高了转变温度识别可信度；5 K 磁滞 Hc 约 600 Oe。而薄 Si/HoCo₂ 信号在高场叠加 Si 基底抗磁斜率，故磁矩归一化到真实薄膜体积和空基底扣除需要写明。体块约 1 K 热滞后、薄膜无可分辨热滞后这一对比很有意思，但只凭两片薄膜不能证明维度效应是唯一原因：Ho 偏富、应力、氧化、晶粒尺寸也可改变相变性质。若要做强结论，需厚度序列并在同一膜上同步测变温结构，检验体块的立方—四方变化是否保留。

sections.title: 图解的解释边界与补充质量验证
sections.text: 本期原创厚度/成分图把“35±1、37±2 nm”和“Ho 35.3 at.%”放在一起，只是说明不同测量/不同量纲如何共同制约薄膜解读。它不显示逐点误差，也不能作为相分数图。更强的结构验证应在 GI-XRD 调入射角的同时测至少多个薄膜反射，若信号太弱则用同步辐射二维衍射或截面选区电子衍射，并配截面 EELS 分辨 SiO₂/HoCo₂ 界面。磁测量可对同片在升温/降温不同速率下测 χ(T) 和 dχ/dT，再以本炉块体靶在相同仪器和扫描速率下作对照；这样热滞后是否真的消失更可比。两片膜 TC 接近说明工艺具有初步重复性，但没有跨靶材、跨天和厚度序列，不宜称普遍厚度效应。若后续出现与体块不同的结构转变，再讨论磁热响应变化将更有物理基础。

readingGuide.first: 先看靶材 XRD 与膜 XRR/GI-XRD，再比薄膜/体块的热滞后曲线。
readingGuide.focus: 核 35±1 与 37±2 nm 的拟合模型、Ho 偏富及空基底背景；应用前景可略。
readingGuide.next: 在同一靶次做温度梯度并加空托氧背景。

papers.title: Solid-state reaction synthesis of superconducting refractory-metal germanides for Ge/SiGe quantum devices
papers.authors: Sebastiaan R. Roelofs; Jan Cornelis Wolff; Nick van Loo; Karina L. Hudson; Giordano Scappucci; Greg P. Mazur
papers.institutions: 完整作者见 arXiv；单位以正文署名为准
papers.journal: arXiv:2610.05210（10 月 6 日官方列表）
papers.access: 全文精读：公开作者稿 主文、Methods、图表及图注；未实际打开的 SI 不计入。
papers.method: 低温外延金属化；超导接触
papers.abstract: Solid-phase reactions offer a route to integrate superconductors into Ge/SiGe heterostructures, but forming high-quality superconducting layers near the buried Ge quantum well remains challenging. We investigate reactions of V, Ta, and Nb with elemental Ge and with the Si$_{0.2}$Ge$_{0.8}$ barrier of Ge/SiGe heterostructures at processing temperatures of 365-390 $^\circ$C. Cross-sectional electron microscopy and low-temperature electrical transport show that deposition on Ge at 390 $^\circ$C, in which approximately 2 nm metal increments are separated by growth stops for in-situ annealing, produces reactions throughout the deposited films and superconducting transitions at approximately 0.14 K for V-Ge, 2.1 K for Ta-Ge, and 2.8 K for Nb-Ge. The Nb-Ge layer has an out-of-plane critical field of approximately 0.8 T at 2.1 K. In the heterostructure samples, intermixing is confined to regions approximately 5-12 nm thick near the metal-SiGe interface, leaving a substantial residual metal layer. Microscopy and transport together suggest that this residual film dominates the measured superconducting response. These results establish low-temperature formation of superconducting refractory-metal-Ge layers while identifying the limited interfacial reaction as the principal obstacle to extending this approach toward the buried quantum well.
papers.conclusion: 这篇给半导体量子阱上超导接触的热预算和前处理窗口：30–40 nm 过渡金属以分步生长/退火或连续沉积形成超导锗化物，Ta-Ge、Nb-Ge、V-Ge 的 Tc 相差很大。分步与连续工艺及基底同时变化时，不能将 Tc 差异只归因于一种变量。

sections.title: 样品谱系与制备
sections.text: Ge 量子阱 16 nm、上部 Si₀.₂Ge₀.₈ 势垒 55 nm，工艺上限约 500 °C。Ge 氧化物在 90 °C 去离子水 10 min 处理，SiOx 用 HF:H₂O=1:7 浸 30 s，IPA/N₂ 后 1–2 min 入仓；电子束蒸发 V/Ta/Nb 30–40 nm，基底 365–390 °C、真空约 10⁻⁹–10⁻⁷ mbar。分步沉积约 2 nm、速率 0.05–0.1 Å/s、每步退火 5–15 min；与连续方案比较。

sections.title: 质量—输运
sections.text: STEM/EDX 约 10% 金属/Ge 计量误差，部分器件加 AlOx 10 nm 盖层，Nb/SiGe 一例先加 Ta 3 nm。四端锁相 20 mK–K，电流 0.1–1 μA，面外 1 T/面内 5.5 T；Tc 取 R=0.1RN。Ta-Ge≈2.1 K、Nb-Ge≈2.8 K；V-Ge 分步约 135 mK、连续约 4.0–4.15 K。接触电阻、局部化学相和量子阱迁移率需同时核，不能只按最高 Tc 排名。

sections.title: 下一片
sections.text: 在同一 Ge/SiGe 晶圆分区随机化 V 沉积为分步/连续，保持总厚、温度和清洗一致；做截面 STEM/EDX、多点 R(T)、临界电流和量子阱迁移率，报告有效接触面积。

sections.title: 为什么同片对照关键
sections.text: 文章先在本征 Ge 片验证金属锗化，再迁移到 55 nm Si₀.₂Ge₀.₈ 势垒之上；这种设计区分“金属本身能否在 390 °C 以下反应”与“SiGe 阻挡层里能否扩散/形成合适相”。V/Ge 分步 15×2 nm、390 °C、每段等待 5 min 的截面 EDX 见原始界面附近残余氧及下方空洞，作者提出 Ge 快扩散、空位在原界面下方聚集的 Kirkendall 机制。这是由形貌/元素分布推断的机制，而不是直接拍摄原子扩散轨迹；可用不同退火时间序列和惰性标记层进一步测试。

sections.title: 评价超导接触不能只看 Tc
sections.text: 表 1 对所有样品以 R=0.1RN 定义 Tc，并用同一 10% 判据定义面外临界场，使内部比较较一致；但转变 onset/midpoint/zero 的差别仍可能很大，较高 Tc 未必意味着与量子阱的低电阻透明接触。某些 EDX 比例带星号待核，截面因 FIB/空气暴露存在表面氧化，不应把暴露后的氧层误认为埋藏结原态。下一片应同时报告界面电阻面积乘积、超导能隙、临界电流以及 Ge 量子阱霍尔迁移率；同晶圆区域随机化分步/连续工艺，避免晶圆梯度造成虚假的制程差异。

sections.title: 定量比较时的实验设计
sections.text: 分步 V/Ge 与连续 V/Ge 的 Tc 差别约一个数量级以上，值得优先复现，但若两样品的等待时间、总热预算、实际 Ge 扩散量和表面氧残留都不同，“沉积模式”只是复合工艺标签。建议先在同一 Ge(001) 片用光刻划分四区域：分步有等待、分步无等待、连续后等时退火、连续直接冷却；各区域总 V 量 30 nm、最高 390 °C 不变。再把最好的条件迁移到 SiGe 上，并通过截面 STEM/EDX 与 XPS 记录 V–Ge 相、孔洞和氧标记层。Tc 曲线至少报告 onset、50%、10%、零电阻和转变宽度；若只呈一个 0.1RN 数值，局部短路通道可能伪装成均匀超导。对量子器件还要查看应变 Ge QW 是否因热处理失去迁移率，避免为了更高接触 Tc 破坏被接触的二维空穴气。

papers.title: Paramagnon softening upon doping in oxychloride cuprate superconductors
papers.authors: Chafic Fawaz; Léo Gaspard; Laura Chaix; Luca Laveder; Benjamin Bacq-Labreuil; Victor Porée; Flora Yakhou-Harris; Kurt Kummer; Nicholas B. Brookes; Alessandro Nicolaou; Hajime Yamamoto; Yuichi Okazaki; Ikuya Yamada; Masaki Azuma; David Santos-Cottin; Marie-Aude Méasson; Benjamin Lenz; Matteo d'Astuto
papers.institutions: 完整作者见 arXiv；单位以正文署名为准
papers.journal: arXiv:2610.05160（10 月 6 日官方列表）
papers.access: 全文精读：公开作者稿 主文、Methods、RIXS 图及图注；未实际打开的 SI 不计入。
papers.method: 8 GPa 高压 flux；Cu L₃ RIXS
papers.abstract: Understanding how magnetic excitations and exchange interactions evolve with doping is crucial for deciphering the physics that shapes the phase diagram of high-temperature cuprate superconductors. Here, we clearly determine the behavior of the paramagnon dispersion in the oxychloride cuprate Na$_{x}$Ca$_{2-x}$CuO$_2$Cl$_2$ up to the highest doping level. We find that the paramagnon bandwidth, defined by the energy at the $X$ zone boundary $(0.5,0,0)$, remains unchanged within experimental uncertainty, even though it exhibits significant broadening. In contrast, along the nodal direction $\Gamma-M$ (\textit{i.e.}, from $(0,0,0)$ to $(0.5,0.5,0)$), the paramagnon energy shows a marked softening with doping, with a shift of up to $\Delta E\sim150$ meV at the midpoint of the zone for the highest doping, which is about half of its initial value in the antiferromagnetic phase. Calculations of the dynamical spin structure factor for a one-band Hubbard model, including hopping terms up to the third-nearest neighbor ($t^{\prime\prime}$), explain this behavior and accurately reproduce the observed wave vector dependence and directional variation in the Brillouin zone.
papers.conclusion: 作者以高压 flux 获更高 Na 掺杂单晶，并用 RIXS 对比 x≈0.10 与 0.18 的自旋激发；布里渊区边界 paramagnon 保持，近中心软化。两掺杂样品测量温度不同且都在 Tc 以上，温度/批次与掺杂效应尚需同温对照。

sections.title: 具体高压流程
sections.text: Pt 胶囊装 Ca₂CuO₂Cl₂、NaClO₄（氧化剂/Na 来源）和 NaCl（flux/Na 来源），(Mg,Ca)O 压力介质、石墨炉；8 GPa，30 min 升到 1523 K，保温 30 min，480 min 降到 1073 K 后淬冷。x≈0.10 旧样本 Tc≈13±1 K，新 x≈0.18 样本 Tc≈27±1 K；单炉产率、胶囊具体纯度/配比及晶体尺寸本次已读 Methods 未完整报告。

sections.title: 结构与 RIXS 边界
sections.text: Bruker D8 Venture 核单晶、MPMS3 评估 Tc；ESRF ID32 Cu L₃ 约 930 eV，能量分辨 45–60 meV。x≈0.10 在 25 K、x≈0.18 在 35 K，均高于各自 Tc；谱峰与模型拟合支持 paramagnon 趋势，而非静态磁序直接测定。实际 Na 含量、深度梯度和 RIXS 拟合背景应与样本编号一一对应。

sections.title: 复现建议
sections.text: 下一炉复制 8 GPa 温程并按胶囊记录 NaClO₄/NaCl 摩尔比，抽样 WDS/ICP 量化实际 x；同温 35 K 重测两批 RIXS 和磁化，隔离掺杂与温度。

sections.title: 极化分辨提高“磁峰”可信度
sections.text: RIXS 有三套配置：两套以散射偏振器或入射角依赖区分 spin-flip 与 non-spin-flip，第三套用更高计数率做密集动量扫描。π 入射、σ 出射能选出磁性 spin-flip；π–π 为 non-spin-flip，后者可含多磁振子与电荷响应。偏振器使光子强度降到约 10%，所以细动量图不总能逐点做偏振鉴别；作者先用慢配置确立关键峰的磁性，再用快配置绘色散。这是比单独把 RIXS 宽峰拟合成 paramagnon 更扎实的链条。磁峰用阻尼谐振子、非磁峰用高斯仍要经 45–60 meV 仪器分辨卷积。

sections.title: 掺杂与温度混杂需写清
sections.text: x=0.10 的旧样品测 25 K，约高于 Tc 12 K；x=0.18 的新样品测 35 K，约高于 Tc 8 K。两者都属于正常态，却不处于同一绝对温度，也不是完全相同的 T/Tc，故区中心软化既有掺杂差异，也可能含温度和样品历史贡献。新样品的 Na 浓度主要由超导 onset 作为代理而非直接给出逐晶 WDS/ICP，下一轮必须把实际 x 和胶囊配方连起来。对 flux/HPHT 复现最关键的是 8 GPa、1523 K 保温和 8 h 降温段，同时记录压力释放与淬冷速率；否则容易让实际 Na 分布和晶体缺陷随炉次漂移。

sections.title: 如何判断磁激发是否真的随掺杂变化
sections.text: RIXS 光谱中 elastic line、声子、多磁振子、电荷激发和自旋翻转宽峰会重叠。图 2 的几何以及 πin−σout/πin−πout 选择规则对“这一宽峰是 paramagnon”形成比单条未偏振谱更强的物理依据；但这并不自动证明模型拟合中心能量没有系统误差，必须检查入射/出射几何、弹性线零点和每个 q 的 45–60 meV 分辨。尤其在区中心峰变软、谱权重分散时，阻尼谐振子的参数之间高度相关，若只展示最佳拟合曲线而不显示残差与参数协方差，就可能把背景变化误当能量位移。下次同温 35 K、同一 q 网格测 x=0.10 和 x=0.18，并保留极化分辨的关键 q 点作为锚；实际 x 的直接成分证据应和 MPMS onset 并列。若两个批次同温同几何仍有软化，才更可靠地归给掺杂。

readingGuide.first: 先读高压 Pt 胶囊流程与 x 的确定，再看 25/35 K Cu L₃ 动量色散图。
readingGuide.focus: 核 45–60 meV 分辨卷积、x=0.10/0.18 的同温对照；超导背景可略。
readingGuide.next: 在同温下重做两掺杂 RIXS，保存胶囊批次和实际 Na 数据。

papers.title: Floquet dressing of bulk metallic bands in 2H-NbSe2
papers.authors: Cong Li; Qirui Cui; Maciej Dendzik; Magnus H. Berntsen; Wanyu Chen; Zhilin Li; Anna Delin; Wentao Zhang; Oscar Tjernberg
papers.institutions: 完整作者见 arXiv；单位以正文署名为准
papers.journal: arXiv:2610.04958（10 月 6 日官方列表）
papers.access: 全文精读：公开作者稿 主文、Methods、图 1–4 与图注；未实际打开的 SI 不计入。
papers.method: 碘 CVT；时间分辨 ARPES
papers.abstract: Floquet dressing offers a route to controlling electronic states through periodic optical driving. Its realization in solids has centred primarily on topological-insulator surface states, semiconductors and two-dimensional Dirac semimetals. Extending this control to bulk metals would enable manipulation of the itinerant states underlying metallic transport and collective order. Yet strong screening and rapid scattering have long cast doubt on its feasibility in bulk metals, while photoelectron dressing complicates its identification. Here we identify Floquet dressing of the overlapping, bulk-derived metallic bands of 2H-NbSe2 using time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. Photon-shifted replicas in a sparse unoccupied-state window retain the parent-band dispersions and appear only during pump--probe overlap. Rotating the pump's linear polarization at fixed probe polarization redistributes replica weight between momentum-space branches. With a common parameter set, a model accounting for the optical fields inside and outside the solid captures this redistribution through coherent Floquet--Volkov interference more closely than either pathway alone or their incoherent intensity sum. These findings extend Floquet dressing to the itinerant bulk bands of a multiband metal without relying on the observation of energy gaps opened by hybridization between parent bands and their photon-dressed replicas, providing a basis for exploring how coherent optical dressing couples to metallic transport and collective electronic phases.
papers.conclusion: 碘 CVT 制备毫米级 NbSe₂，6 K 飞秒泵浦后 trARPES 见母带旁复制带；作者用 Floquet 与光电子末态 Volkov 联合模型解释偏振依赖。看到复制带不等于直接证明初态 Floquet 重整化，能量与偏振对照才是关键。

sections.title: 生长和结构
sections.text: Nb 粉与 Se 块按计量、碘输运剂 1 mg/mL，封真空石英，在 850→670 °C 梯度下约两周后自然冷却，得到约 3 mm 单晶。原料纯度、管长、装料总质量、每批产率与完整单晶 XRD/EDS 数值在所读 Methods 未报告。

sections.title: 光谱几何与解释
sections.text: trARPES 于 6 K、UHV<10⁻¹⁰ mbar，18 eV probe、1030 nm/1.2 eV pump、250 kHz、约 250 fs。泵探时序与偏振改变副本强度；侧带能量间隔和偏振映射是直接观察，Floquet/Volkov 相对权重来自相干模型。需以不同泵强、探针光子能与表面老化检查末态/空间电荷贡献。

sections.title: 下一次
sections.text: 同一晶面做泵偏振旋转、能量/光子数依赖和泵关闭基线，测样品温升；将 NbSe₂ 批次、解理面、表面时间与模型参数绑定。

sections.title: 光电子副本的双重来源
sections.text: Floquet 初态侧带与出射电子受到泵场调制产生的 Volkov 末态侧带，都会在泵探重叠时产生约泵光子能量间隔的复制带。文章用偏振、能动量及联合模型比较区分两者，因此“看见副本”不是逻辑终点。值得检查图中延迟时间和泵功率扫描：如果副本只在泵探重叠强，支持相干瞬态；但这仍可能有末态成分。6 K 超导态、CDW 背景与约 250 fs 分辨也决定能否谈量子态的持久改变。

sections.title: 从生长到谱学的样品历史
sections.text: I₂ 浓度约 1 mg/mL、850→670 °C 两周的 CVT 条件是可操作的；然而单晶约 3 mm 并不说明层错、Se 缺陷或表面污染密度。解理后 UHV<10⁻¹⁰ mbar 的停留时间、每次 pump 曝光剂量、低温热稳态和 spot-to-spot 谱形应并入谱学数据库。更强的复现会把同炉不同晶体的 XRD/EDS/RRR 与副本能量/强度关联，检验 Floquet 模型参数是否随着样品质量变化。

readingGuide.first: 先读 CVT Methods，再看侧带随泵/探偏振变化的图与模型分解。
readingGuide.focus: 核 250 fs 时间分辨与副本线宽、Volkov 末态对照；Floquet 教程可略。
readingGuide.next: 在同一解理面扫描 probe 能量并监测空间电荷/热漂移。

papers.title: Anisotropic mesoscale magnetic scattering across the spin-reorientation transition in TbMn6Sn6
papers.authors: Zhuang Xu; Fan Chen; Hui Cheng; Xinmin Wang; Taisen Zuo; He Cheng; Haitao Hu; Cuiping Zhang; Qian Zhao; Michel Kenzelmann; Jonathan S. White; Junying Shen; Xin Tong
papers.institutions: 完整作者见 arXiv；单位以正文署名为准
papers.journal: arXiv:2610.04903（10 月 6 日官方列表）
papers.access: 全文精读：公开作者稿 主文、Methods、图 1–5；SI 只见引用未读；未实际打开的 SI 不计入。
papers.method: Sn self-flux；小角中子散射
papers.abstract: TbMn6Sn6 is a centrosymmetric ferrimagnetic kagome metal that combines topological electronic states with strong magnetic anisotropy and a near-room-temperature spin-reorientation transition (SRT). Real-space imaging studies of thin specimens have revealed helical stripes, biskyrmion-like textures, and skyrmion-bubble-like structures in the spin-reorientation regime. Whether such local textures develop into a bulk long-range-ordered skyrmion lattice remains unresolved. Here we present small-angle neutron scattering (SANS) results probing the mesoscale magnetism of a bulk TbMn6Sn6 single crystal. We observe no sixfold SANS Bragg pattern indicative of a long-range-ordered skyrmion lattice under the explored conditions. Instead, the dominant magnetic response is an anisotropic twofold low-Q scattering component whose intensity distribution and field dependence evolve markedly across the spin-reorientation regime. In zero field, a broad and horizontally elongated low-Q signal develops above TSR and weakens as the system approaches the paramagnetic state. At 345 K with H || b, the signal is diffuse and is suppressed rapidly below about 700 Oe. By contrast, at 310 K with H || c, close to TSR, the response is more concentrated and line-shaped and persists to higher fields. The contrasts between these scans likely reflect the combined effects of rapidly evolving magnetic anisotropy near TSR and the field geometry. Our results therefore establish a bulk anisotropic mesoscale magnetic response across the spin-reorientation regime, consistent with stripe- or domain-related textures reported by real-space imaging, while not uniquely identifying their real-space morphology.
papers.conclusion: SANS 在 310 K 以上观察两重弥散磁信号而无六重 Bragg 峰，对体相长程有序斯格明子晶格构成约束。不同场向/温度下信号抑制不同，但比较条件并非完全正交，不能直接给出单一磁机制。

sections.title: 样品质量与方法
sections.text: 单晶采用文中引用的 Sn self-flux 既有路线，本论文未提供本炉 Sn:Mn:Tb 比例和具体温程，不得借用别文当作本炉记录。样品约 121 mg、6.7×5.7×0.6 mm，Laue/XRD 确定取向，约 308 K 有自旋重取向。

sections.title: SANS 证据链
sections.text: PSI SANS-I，波长 11 Å、带宽约 10%、探测器距 18 m、束沿 b。约 320–380 K 双重弥散散射强，近 400 K 衰减；未出现六重峰。345 K H∥b 到约 700 Oe 被压制；310 K H∥c 则延续到较高场。q* 来自有限相关长度信号，不能简单写成真实条纹周期。温度与场向同时改变，需做二维矩阵分离。

sections.title: 下一次
sections.text: 同一晶体固定 345 K 做 H∥b/c 的 SANS 与磁化，再固定 H 扫过 308 K；对多批次记录 Sn 残余和晶体取向，避免碎片与装夹导致假双重图案。

sections.title: SANS 的肯定证据和否定证据
sections.text: 二维探测器在特定温区显示双重而非六重分布；SANS 对长周期、体相、有限波矢有序敏感，因此“没有六重峰”对某些理想长程 skyrmion crystal 模型不利。然而有限相关长度、体积分数很小、取向分布或探测 q 窗外的纹理仍可能逃过该实验，不能把阴性结果写成完全排除一切斯格明子。作者对 345 K H∥b 与 310 K H∥c 的比较同时改变温度和场向，故方向效应不能由这两条曲线单独识别。

sections.title: 几何与样品要求
sections.text: 121 mg 大单晶和 6.7×5.7×0.6 mm 尺寸足以提供 SANS 计数，但 Sn self-flux 的投料/倾析温度未在本稿重新给出，生长记录必须另取原始参考文献或实验室炉次本。11 Å 中子、约 10% 波长展宽与 18 m 探测距离限定 q 分辨；图像要做空白、背景和核散射扣除并保留原始二维图，不应只归档径向积分。下一次最有效的是同温、同样品、同 q 窗按 H∥b/c 双方向扫描，并在 308 K 两侧做密温步长。

readingGuide.focus: 核 11 Å/10% 分辨卷积、345 K 与 310 K 非同温比较；宏观 skyrmion 背景可略。
readingGuide.next: 同温改变场向重测二维 Q 图。

papers.title: Magneto-transport and electronic structure studies of ternary antimonides, LaTSb_2 (T = Cu, Ag)
papers.authors: Himanshu Pant; Neeraj Bhatt; Deepali Sharma; Asif Ali; A. Thamizhavel; Saurabh Singh; Kentaro Kuga; Tsunehiro Takeuchi; Ravi Shankar Singh; R. Bindu
papers.institutions: 完整作者见 arXiv；单位以正文署名为准
papers.journal: arXiv:2610.04290（10 月 6 日官方列表）
papers.access: 全文精读：公开作者稿 主文、Experimental/Methods、图 1–4；未实际打开的 SI 不计入。
papers.method: Sb self-flux；XPS/UPS 与磁输运
papers.abstract: We investigate Sb square net-based Dirac semimetallic ternary antimonides La$T$Sb$_2$ ($T$ = Cu, Ag) using magnetotransport and photoelectron spectroscopic studies, complemented by density functional theory (DFT) based ab initio calculations. Our results show that both compounds exhibit a positive temperature coefficient of resistivity, linear magnetoresistance (MR), and a deviation from Fermi liquid behaviour at low temperatures (2-30 K). But only $T$ = Ag compound exhibit signature of charge density wave (CDW) phenomena and the results of its temperature dependent MR data suggest that single-band semiclassical transport is not sufficient to understand the transport behaviour. $\text{DFT}+U$ studies show that in both samples, an on-site Coulomb interaction ($U$) for Cu 3$d$ and Ag 4$d$ electrons, in the presence of spin-orbit coupling (SOC) is required to reproduce experimental valence band spectra. Sb 3$d$, 4$d$ core-level spectra combined with $\text{DFT}+U$ calculations and La 3$d$ spectra confirm the presence and effects of inequivalent Sb sites for both the samples. In contrast to the $T$ = Cu compound, which follows expected temperature-dependent core-level sharpening, the $T$ = Ag compound exhibits an anomalous low-temperature broadening in the CDW phase. The analysis of Sb 3$d$ spectra suggests Sb square nets are linked to CDW phenomena in the $T$ = Ag compound. Temperature-dependent ultraviolet photoemission spectroscopic studies on $T$ = Ag show a small decrement in spectral DOS at the $\epsilon_F$ for the temperature below the CDW transition temperature. These core-level studies provide a valuable spectroscopic benchmark for comparing CDW and non-CDW systems and clarifying the role of local electronic environments in CDW formation.
papers.conclusion: Sb 自助熔剂的 LaCuSb₂/LaAgSb₂ 在低温磁阻与表面光电子谱上差异明显，LaAgSb₂ 有多段密度波异常。作者提出 Dirac/量子极限关联，但 9 T 磁阻及 Kohler 违背不足以独立证明只剩最低 Landau 能级；多带和 CDW 重构同样需要检验。

sections.title: 样品与工艺边界
sections.text: Sb self-flux 具体投料比、坩埚、温度/冷速沿用前人文献，当前正文未重新报告。结构属 LaTSb₂ 层状体系，空间群、真实计量与晶体尺寸需依据原位单晶衍射/EDS 才能确定，不能由化学式填补。

sections.title: 输运—光电子证据
sections.text: 四探针 PPMS 约 300–2.2 K、I∥ab、磁场至 9 T；XPS 30/300 K 用 Al Kα 1486.6 eV，UPS He I 21.2 eV/He II 48.37 eV，UHV~10⁻¹¹ mbar。LaAgSb₂ 在约 205/182/155 K 有 CDW 相关异常、LaCuSb₂ 未见；低温 ρ∝Tⁿ 的 n≈2.46(2)/2.65(2)。9 T LaAgSb₂ 磁阻约为 LaCuSb₂ 十倍，横纵向比约 2.6 对 1.3；定量值随几何与背景须复核。

sections.title: 下一步
sections.text: 同炉两化合物做角度和高场量子振荡，并以 XRD/EDS/XPS 化学分析排除 Sb 残留和表面老化。Kohler 违背可由多带、散射率各向异性或 CDW 产生。

sections.title: 解释线性磁阻前先排工艺差异
sections.text: LaAgSb₂ 三个 CDW 相关异常约 205/182/155 K，而 LaCuSb₂ 无对应特征，这意味着低温费米面和散射本来就不同；磁阻大小十倍差别不能简单归给一个拓扑量。9 T 内若要声称量子极限，须由量子振荡频率估最低能级占据、并在多个磁场窗口检验线性斜率；Kohler 定律违背可来自多带寿命或 CDW 相干长度变化。XPS/UPS 还需防表面氧化与光照历史，30 K 与 300 K 不能在不同清洁度表面直接解释温变电子结构。

sections.title: 生长配方缺失的处理
sections.text: 本稿写 Sb 自助熔剂并引用先前方法，但没有本炉装料比、最高温、降温率、倾析点和晶体产率。本简报不能把其他 LaTSb₂ 论文的参数当作这批样品实际工艺。复现前先追作者引用的原始生长文献；同时保存每片 La:Cu/Ag:Sb 的 WDS、Laue 和偏光照片，并在同样几何上测 RRR、Hall、横/纵向磁阻，才能把材料成分差异与测量几何差异拆开。

readingGuide.first: 先读 205/182/155 K 电阻异常，再看 9 T 横纵磁阻和 UPS/XPS 对照。
readingGuide.focus: 核自助熔剂配方是否在参考文献、n 拟合窗口和“量子极限”场尺度；引言可略。
readingGuide.next: 以同批晶体做更高场 Hall/振荡与表面老化序列。

papers.material: MgO 上 NbN/AlN/NbN 外延结
papers.title: Sidewall spacer passivated epitaxial NbN/AlN/NbN Josephson junctions for superconducting qubit applications
papers.authors: Koki Honda; Daiki Kurihara; Hiroki Kutsuma; Hirotaka Terai; Taro Yamashita
papers.institutions: 完整作者见 arXiv；单位以正文署名为准
papers.journal: arXiv:2610.04820（10 月 6 日官方列表）
papers.access: 全文精读：公开作者稿 公开 HTML 主文、Methods、图 1–4；未实际打开的 SI 不计入。
papers.method: 室温磁控溅射；约瑟夫森结 I–V
papers.abstract: Epitaxial NbN/AlN/NbN Josephson junctions are promising alternatives to conventional Al/AlO$_x$/Al junctions for superconducting qubits due to their crystalline tunnel barriers and the high transition temperature of NbN. However, their integration into quantum circuits typically requires complex fabrication processes involving amorphous interlayer dielectrics, which can degrade qubit coherence times. To address these issues, we developed sidewall spacer passivated epitaxial NbN/AlN/NbN junctions using a fabrication process that reduces both the volume of amorphous dielectric material and fabrication complexity. The fabricated junctions exhibited a large gap voltage of approximately 5.6 mV and low subgap leakage currents. By varying the thickness of the AlN tunnel barrier, high-quality junctions were fabricated over a wide range of critical current densities ${\it J}_c$, from 0.3 to 10$^4$ A/cm$^2$. In addition, the comparison of the current-voltage characteristics before and after buffered hydrofluoric acid treatment indicated that the wet etching process did not degrade the electrical characteristics of the junctions. These results establish a scalable fabrication process for epitaxial Josephson junctions and provide a promising platform for high-coherence nitride-based superconducting qubits.
papers.conclusion: 不破真空室温反应溅射和可控 AlN 障壁制成自分流结，2.3 K I–V 的 Jc 跨多个量级。该论文证明结工艺与输运窗口，并不直接测量量子比特相干；不能把同日另篇 qubit 结果并到该器件上。

sections.title: 外延与制程
sections.text: MgO(100) 单晶溶剂超声、离子束清洗；NbN/AlN/NbN 反应直流磁控溅射，室温连续、不破真空。无掩模光刻、Ar/Cl₂/BCl₃ ICP-RIE，280 °C PECVD SiO₂ 间隔层、Ar/CF₄/CHF₃ 刻蚀、再溅射 NbN 接线。AlN 名义厚 1.27/1.54/1.77/2.09 nm 来自速率×时间，并非逐个 TEM 实测。

sections.title: 电学与质量
sections.text: 2.3 K I–V 约 5.6 mV 能隙，Jc≈0.3–10⁴ A/cm²；低 Jc 的 Rsg/Rn≈100，高 Jc >10。BHF 湿蚀后 I–V 未见明显劣化。电流密度依赖面积/边缘损伤，宏观比值不替代单结缺陷统计；需 TEM/EELS 和室温漏电分布。

sections.title: 下一片
sections.text: 对 AlN 厚度做随机位置矩阵，截面 TEM 验障壁连续性，测每片 I–V 分布与低频噪声；与 qubit 制造数据分开记录。

sections.title: 厚度误差如何影响结统计
sections.text: AlN 从约 1.27 到 2.09 nm，名义厚度来自生长速率乘时间。隧穿电流对厚度近指数敏感，哪怕亚埃级粗糙/台阶也可主导 Jc 分布；故“平均厚度精准”不是低缺陷的充分条件。电流密度按光刻有效面积计算，但边缘刻蚀与侧墙绝缘可能改变实际导电面积。Rsg/Rn 高说明亚能隙漏电较低，仍须从多个电压点和不同结面积排除微短路或针孔。

sections.title: 两篇 NbN 论文的证据边界
sections.text: 同一官方列表另有 arXiv:2610.04821 报自分流 flux qubit 的 797 MHz 非谐性与 13–25 μs 寿命。它与本篇工艺路线有关，但本篇只给结 I–V 和加工可靠性，不能把另文寿命当作本篇所有结的结果。研究生工作平台中应让“晶圆—结—量子比特—测量”形成样品谱系，关联各结障壁厚度、BHF 处理、刻蚀批次和 qubit T₁/T₂。

readingGuide.priority: A｜MgO 上 NbN/AlN/NbN 外延结
readingGuide.first: 先看 1.27–2.09 nm 障壁序列与 Jc 图，再读刻蚀/接线 Methods。
readingGuide.focus: 核厚度是否实际测量、面积校正及 BHF 前后同结配对； qubit 应用可略。
readingGuide.next: 同晶圆做 TEM 抽样与每种厚度至少多结 Jc 分布。

papers.title: Integrating spin glass dynamics into nanomechanical resonators
papers.authors: S.Y. Grebenchuk; T.M. Savilov; Y.W. Ho; A.K. Grebenko; M. Kravtsov; J.M. Wolf; D.A. Litvinov; Z. Yang; P. Cai; S. Ramachandran; R. Duan; L. Zheng; B. Özyilmaz; G. Eda; E.J.G. Santos; M. Koperski; K.S. Novoselov; M. Šiškins
papers.institutions: 完整作者见 arXiv；单位以正文署名为准
papers.journal: arXiv:2610.03891（10 月 6 日官方列表）
papers.access: 全文精读：公开作者稿 主文、Methods、低温 MFM 与机械曲线；未实际打开的 SI 不计入。
papers.method: CVT 单晶；MFM 与纳米机械共振
papers.abstract: Spin glasses are non-equilibrium magnetic systems with pronounced slow relaxation, ageing, and chaotic, synaptic-like properties, whose unique history-dependent dynamics have remained difficult to harness in functional devices. Two-dimensional van der Waals spin-glass magnets offer a route to overcome this limitation by allowing controlled coupling between magnetic and mechanical degrees of freedom. Here, we demonstrate the integration of a spin-glass functionality in nanoelectromechanical systems (NEMS) using thin exfoliated NbFeTe$_2$ films, which establishes a robust spin-glass state down to a few tens of nanometer-thick layers. Using cryogenic magnetic force microscopy, we reveal characteristic slow, hour-scale macroscopic magnetic relaxation, associated with glassy reorganisation of its magnetic domain clusters. Incorporation of thin NbFeTe$_2$ into membrane resonators allows the transduction of this glassy magnetic domain relaxation into strain, shifting their mechanical resonance frequency. This provides a functional nanomechanical readout of spin-glass dynamics and establishes a versatile platform for integrating frustrated magnetism into NEMS.
papers.conclusion: 论文把低温磁畴松弛与悬膜机械频率变化关联，提出自旋玻璃磁弹耦合。MFM 直接看到畴态、共振频率直接量到应力代理；磁性导致应力的方向仍需非磁性或成分对照和同步测量排除热漂移。

sections.title: 生长与器件谱系
sections.text: 前驱体 750 °C 2 d，CVT 800→700 °C 14 d；Ar 手套箱剥离，O₂/H₂O<0.5 ppm；悬膜腔宽 1–4 μm、深约 285 nm，片厚最低约 10 nm。输运剂名称/剂量、封管真空、原料纯度和各厚度器件良率在已读 Methods 未完整报告，不能凭 CVT 习惯填补。

sections.title: 温度—磁场—时间
sections.text: MFM 在 1.7 K 观察低温畴；纳米机械共振在约 2 K 与 10 K 做长期跟踪，温度稳定后观察约 40 h，改变至 1 T 磁场会影响松弛。频率漂移和 MFM 图像是观察，自旋玻璃松弛时间/磁弹系数属模型判断。需要记录激光功率、腔体热漂移和氧化暴露。

sections.title: 下一次
sections.text: 同一母晶做磁性 NbFeTe₂/非磁性对照、不同厚度与空腔，磁场阶跃同步采集 MFM/机械频率；把每条频率曲线的等待时间作为原始元数据保存。

sections.title: 机械共振能量标度
sections.text: 悬膜频率受张力、质量、几何尺寸和温度共同控制；若磁畴缓慢松弛改变磁致伸缩张力，频率漂移可以作为其间接代理，但不能只凭一条 f(t) 判断磁相。MFM 在 1.7 K 的纹理和 2/10 K 共振不是完全同条件同步测量，需考虑 MFM 探针本身的扰动。1–4 μm 腔与 285 nm 深度决定边界张力，片厚最低约 10 nm 与较厚器件的质量/应力不能简单归一比较。

sections.title: 时间序列如何复现
sections.text: 约 40 h 的等待时间意味着启动阶段热漂移和设备稳定性不是可忽略噪声。每条曲线应附样品温度、腔压、激光功率、磁场支路、起始时间戳和光照历史；用空腔及非磁薄片跑同样 40 h，若同样漂移则不能把时间常数赋予自旋玻璃。CVT 输运剂剂量在已读 Methods 中未完整给出，下一炉先向作者或补充数据求证，不按常见卤素浓度猜测。

readingGuide.first: 先读 CVT/悬膜 Methods，再比较 2 K/10 K 与 1 T 阶跃的频率时间曲线。
readingGuide.focus: 核 40 h 稳定过程、腔深 285 nm 和 MFM 扰动；自旋玻璃一般综述可略。
readingGuide.next: 做空腔/非磁性薄片的同温同激光频率漂移对照。

papers.material: AB 双层石墨烯 THz 纳米光伏
papers.title: Terahertz nanoscopy of quantum-geometric photovoltaics in bilayer graphene
papers.authors: Bogdan Borodin; Jiangxu Li; Xuanpu Zhang; Aleksei Karaborchev; Som Subhra Guria; Kenji Watanabe; Takashi Taniguchi; Roshan Krishna Kumar; Fan Zhang; Petr Stepanov
papers.institutions: 完整作者见 arXiv；单位以正文署名为准
papers.journal: arXiv:2610.05620（10 月 6 日官方列表）
papers.access: 全文精读：公开作者稿 公开 HTML 主文、器件及图 1–4；未核 SI；未实际打开的 SI 不计入。
papers.method: 双栅器件；低温近场 THz 显微
papers.abstract: The bulk photovoltaic effect (BPVE) provides a direct link between quantum geometry and nonlinear light-matter interactions, yet conventional far-field measurements cannot disentangle BPVE from contact- and interface-induced photothermoelectric signals. Here we develop cryogenic, polarization-sensitive terahertz microscopy with deep-subwavelength resolution and apply it to dual-gated AB bilayer graphene. Near resonance between the band gap and terahertz photon energy, we observe enhanced optical conductivity and spatially resolved BPVE. Polarization-dependent measurements reveal a characteristic twofold angular symmetry and a distinct shift-vector direction, both governed by crystalline symmetries and quantum geometry. The evolution of BPVE with carrier density and temperature provides a sensitive probe of the fine electronic structure of bilayer graphene, revealing signatures of trigonal warping and electron-hole asymmetry. Agreement with theory demonstrates that the terahertz nanoscopy of BPVE established here offers an optical lens into the interplay between band and quantum geometry in quantum materials.
papers.conclusion: 偏振分辨 THz 纳米显微把双层石墨烯的体光伏响应与接触热电信号在空间上区分，双重角度对称与位移场共振为量子几何解释提供证据。近场探针本身可改变局域电场和热梯度，所以空间对比仍需以不同接触材料与探针功率校验。

sections.title: 问题—器件
sections.text: 作者在 hBN 封装 AB 双层石墨烯上用石墨/石墨烯栅调位移场与带隙，再在低温做深亚波长 THz 近场扫描。主文图 1 给器件几何，图 2–4 比较偏振角、栅压与空间位置；母片来源、转移环境、厚度/界面污染及批次良率在所读材料未完整报告。

sections.title: 直接测量与解释
sections.text: 在光子能量接近电调带隙时光电流和光学响应增强，偏振显示两重角特征，空间地图可把体区与接触附近信号分开。将光电流分为 shift-vector/量子几何贡献需要模型，不能仅据两重角称已直接测量 Berry 曲率。近场热电、接触不对称和栅漏电是剩余替代解释。

sections.title: 复现建议
sections.text: 同器件做不同近场功率、两种接触与栅极极性反转，随位置记录电压与热响应；在同一几何计算允许张量分量，预注册偏振拟合式。

sections.title: 空间图怎样区分体区与接触
sections.text: 远场照明只能给整器件积分电压，接触附近的 Seebeck/热电子响应可和体光伏混在一起。低温偏振敏感 THz 近场扫描把局部响应的位置展开，若体区在换电压电极时保持相关偏振角规律，而接触峰跟局部几何变化，则更支持量子几何源项。仍需注意探针天线场与入射偏振存在空间不均，原始扫描图应同时保存探针高度、功率和栅压。

sections.title: 何时不能称“直接看到了量子度规”
sections.text: 两重角谐波、带隙共振和反转位移场的符号变化是直接测量；将它们映射到 shift vector/量子度规须假设低能能带、接触电场分布和非线性电流张量。若只在接触附近强、或响应随扫描功率非线性升温，应优先解释光热电。建议在同一器件加做近场/远场比、不同探针功率、正负位移场和互换接点，每一步只改变一个变量。

readingGuide.priority: A｜AB 双层石墨烯 THz 纳米光伏
readingGuide.first: 先看图 1–3 的近场几何/接触区域，再看偏振两重角和带隙共振。
readingGuide.focus: 核光热电背景扣除与位移场标定；宽泛 BPVE 背景可略。
readingGuide.next: 换接触材料并做功率依赖近场地图。

papers.title: Out-of-Plane Oscillating Electric Fields Unlock Low-Temperature Nonequilibrium Superionicity in Quasi-Two-Dimensional AgCrSe2
papers.authors: Jia-Wen Li; Kun Yang; Sheng Meng; Xinghua Shi; Wei-Hai Fang; Jin Zhang
papers.institutions: 完整作者见 arXiv；单位以正文署名为准
papers.journal: arXiv:2610.05941（10 月 6 日官方列表）
papers.access: 全文精读：公开作者稿 公开 HTML 主文、模拟方法与主要图；未实际打开的 SI 不计入。
papers.method: 电场驱动机器学习分子动力学
papers.abstract: Superionic conductors enable exceptionally fast ion transport in solids and offer broad technological potential. However, their highly conductive states are typically accessed only above the order-disorder transition of the mobile-ion sublattice, which limits low-temperature operation. Here, electric-field-responsive machine-learning molecular dynamics reveals a nonequilibrium route to superionic transport in quasi-two-dimensional AgCrSe2 driven by an out-of-plane oscillating electric field. At 300 K, far below the transition temperature near 475 K, the field activates fast in-plane Ag+ transport with an ionic conductivity reaching ~1.7 S/cm. This originates from field-driven dynamic disorder of Ag+ across two equivalent sublattices rather than thermally induced disordering. With increasing frequency, the Ag occupation evolves from complete switching to a highly conductive dynamically disordered state and finally to an ordered state with weak field response. These regimes shift to higher frequencies with increasing temperature or field amplitude, consistent with competition between the driving period and Ag-sublattice response time. At strong fields, this timescale is consistent with field-assisted thermal activation, while weak-field deviations suggest additional dynamics beyond single-ion activation. These results suggest timescale-matched periodic driving as a route to transport-active ionic disorder far below an equilibrium superionic transition.
papers.conclusion: 计算提示在 300 K、低于约 475 K 的平衡转变温度时，面外交流场可触发面内 Ag⁺ 超离子运动，电导率估算约 1.7 S/cm。这是非平衡模拟预测，不是 300 K 的样品实测输运；与热驱动超离子相区别需要实验证据。

sections.title: 结构与模型
sections.text: Ag⁺ 层夹在 CrSe₂ 层之间；作者训练电场响应机器学习势并做受驱分子动力学，对比无场与面外振荡场。实际单晶生长、纯度、堆垛/缺陷与实验电极几何：本论文未开展实物测量，不适用实验配方。

sections.title: 数值与局限
sections.text: 约 475 K 是平衡有序—无序转变背景，300 K 模拟下场诱导面内迁移率和约 1.7 S/cm 电导率是模拟/统计量；有限超胞、驱动频率、晶格自热与势的外推范围都可能改变结果。不能把离子扩散图解读为新稳定晶相。

sections.title: 下一实验

sections.title: 受驱模拟的可证伪性

papers.abstract: Understanding quantum interactions in van der Waals magnets are critical to realizing their potential for next-generation magnetic, electronic, and spintronic applications. In this study, we investigated the evolution of exchange and dipole-dipole interactions in van der Waals magnet CrCl3 using multifrequency broadband (1-16 GHz) magnetic resonance on a bulk single-crystal CrCl3 sample. We found that the dipolar-broadened low-field resonance linewidth narrows due to exchange narrowing at higher resonance fields. Our findings show that the exchange interaction evolves exponentially as we lower the sample temperature from room temperature to 50 K. However, we found that the dipole-dipole interaction remains constant in the same temperature range. We have also detected the half-field magnetic resonance transition at room temperature, indicating a robust dipole-dipole interaction among spins. The measured inter-spin distance is 2.4(3) A at room temperature. The evolution of dipole interactions, the observation of half-field magnetic resonance, and the strong exchange interaction indicate short-range ordering/correlation in CrCl3 at temperatures far above the magnetic global ordering temperature. This study also demonstrates the significance and sensitivity of the multifrequency electron spin resonance technique for understanding quantum interactions and magnetic correlations in van der Waals magnetic materials.
papers.conclusion: 摘要显示 1–16 GHz 共振线宽随磁场/温度变化，作者用交换窄化解释低场偶极展宽减小；交换常数的温度演化是拟合而非直接观测。

papers.abstract: The epitaxial graphene grown on SiC interface has been the subject of tremendous research efforts to control its electronic transport properties in the quest for graphene electronic applications. The electronic structure of the epitaxial graphene buffer layer on SiC(0001) is investigated at the atomic scale using monochromated electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) in an aberration-corrected scanning transmission electron microscope (STEM). The C $K$-edge reveals spectral fine structures distinctly different from free-standing graphene layer, providing direct experimental evidence of a modified bonding environment. Ab initio calculations providing a site-resolved probe of orbital character to elucidate the origin of these spectral features: covalent bonding between one-quarter of the buffer-layer carbon atoms and the substrate silicon atoms induces partial $\mathrm{sp}^3$ hybridization, quenching the out-of-plane $\pi$ states and disrupting $\pi$-conjugation across the interfacial layer. Substrate-imposed symmetry breaking further lifts the in-plane orbital degeneracy. This orbital-engineering framework, rooted in $\pi$-state quenching and site-specific symmetry breaking, establishes a quantitative basis for tailoring graphene-substrate interfaces toward next-generation low-energy transistor applications.

papers.title: Identification and Structural Decomposition of Hidden Defect Configurations: A Case Study of Charged Oxygen Divacancies in HfO_2
papers.authors: Hyunjin Lee; Yoon Kyeung Lee; Keun Heo; Shi Liu; Taehun Lee
papers.institutions: 完整作者见 arXiv；单位以正文署名为准

papers.abstract: Extensive configurational searches have revealed hidden defect structures in crystalline compounds, yet how their local bonding arrangements modify the surrounding atomic environment remains less well understood. We examine this question in hafnium oxide (HfO$_2$), which hosts energetically competing monoclinic (M), tetragonal (T), and polar orthorhombic (PO) polymorphs. For the $c$-axis oxygen-divacancy complex ($T_c$), a local-distortion search with density-functional theory (DFT) relaxation under tetragonal-lattice confinement identifies a hidden family of low-energy configurations ($T_c^{*}$). For the fully charged complex ($2\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{O}}^{2+}$), structural decomposition using Smooth Overlap of Atomic Positions (SOAP) descriptors reveals mixed M-, T-, and PO-like character, supported by independent analyses of Hf coordination and bond geometry. The idealized $T_c$ reference connects barrierlessly to the lowest-energy mixed-motif $T_c^{*}$ configuration, lowering the energy by $18.4$ meV/f.u. within the confined landscape. After releasing the lattice constraint, we compare transformation pathways to M and PO using solid-state nudged elastic band calculations with cell-relaxed endpoints. The respective barriers increase from $6.9$ and $10.1$ meV/f.u. for the idealized reference to $26.9$ and $15.3$ meV/f.u. for the $T_c^{*}$-derived structure. The larger increase for M makes PO, rather than M, the lower-barrier branch. This case study shows how structural decomposition connects hidden defect configurations with changes in the surrounding atomic environment and kinetic branching between competing polymorphs.
papers.conclusion: 作者在四方 HfO₂ 中找到以往易漏检的低能带电氧双空位构型，说明“给定空位数”仍不确定局域键合与极性相稳定性。纯计算结果不能直接称为实验确证的铁电缺陷。

papers.authors: C. K. Wei; Z. J. Chen; J. T. Song; S. H. Ma; W. H. Liu; J. H. Wu; Z. W. Huang; Jinwei Rao; Wei Lu; Bimu Yao

papers.abstract: Spatiotemporal microwave magnetic-field imaging reveals current flow in high-frequency circuits and nonequilibrium spin dynamics, yet probes rarely combine calibrated spectral readout, optics-free operation and transient mapping at room temperature. Here ferrimagnetic order in yttrium iron garnet supports coherent coupling from a pump-induced magnon mode, converting target-field amplitude into a spectral splitting with all-microwave readout. Sampling the calibrated splitting over position and delay reconstructs spatiotemporal imaging of magnetic fields. Continuous-wave measurement reaches a sensitivity of 58 pT/$\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$ and recovers phases across various powers. Combined with time-resolved frequency-comb spectroscopy, the method reconstructs transient fields with a 130-ns response time. Coplanar-waveguide imaging validates the magnetic selectivity of the mode-splitting readout, where measured maps agree with simulated magnetic-field distribution. In a microwave amplifier, our reconstruction resolves nonuniform switching dynamics and detects downstream field suppression from an open-contact fault. Magnonic coherent splitting provides a scalable route for optics-free imaging of spatiotemporal field evolution in functional devices.

papers.abstract: The nonlinear Hall effect (NLHE) holds significant promise for next-generation electronic device applications, and it is essential to explore and engineer a strong and highly tunable NLHE. In this work, we report large second-order and third-order NLHEs in dual-gated BiSbTeSe2 devices. Both the second-order and third-order NLHE are highly gate-tunable. The second-order NLHE exhibits a higher generation efficiency than those reported in previous topological insulator systems, and it can be stably observed up to room temperature. Meanwhile, the generation efficiency of the third-order NLHE is comparable to previously reported values. The scaling analysis indicates that the second-order NLHE is consistent with contributions from skew scattering and a term compatible with either the Berry curvature dipole or side jump, whereas the third-order NLHE is consistent with contributions from the Berry connection polarizability tensor and higher-order skew scattering. Our work establishes a promising experimental platform for the development of NLHE-based devices.

papers.abstract: We demonstrate giant nonlinearity of the kinetic inductance $L_k$ in a superconducting NbN/Al hybrid strip. In contrast to ordinary superconductors, where the maximum observed current-induced variation of $L_k$ does not exceed tens of percent, we observe a 50-fold change in $L_k$. Physically, this effect is connected with the proximity-induced superconductivity in the Al layer and the specific choice of parameters for which the dependence of the superconducting current $I$ on the Cooper pair momentum $\hbar q$ exhibits a plateau at a current $I^*$ {\it well below} the depairing current. Formally, this leads to $L_k \sim dq/dI \to \infty$ as $I \to I^*$. We believe that our results open a new route for creating the next generation of highly sensitive detectors of electromagnetic radiation, calorimeters, parametric amplifiers, and magnetometers.
papers.conclusion: 摘要报告动能电感随电流可变化约 50 倍，作者归因于 Al 的近邻超导及 I(q) 平台。强非线性不直接意味着低损耗器件可用，需损耗/噪声与重复性。

papers.abstract: We report a demonstration of a self-shunted superconducting flux qubit (SSFQ) as an ultracompact, strongly anharmonic, and long-lifetime qubit by using the full epitaxially grown NbN/AlN/NbN Josephson junctions. The NbN-junction-based SSFQ achieved a high anharmonicity of 797 MHz as well as drastically reduced footprint of the qubit compared to capacitively shunted (C-shunt) flux qubits with a large shunt capacitor. The lifetime of the SSFQ reached 13 - 25 $\mu$s, which is comparable to or relatively higher than that of NbN-based C-shunt flux qubits and Al-based flux qubits with more than 10 times smaller junctions. This indicates that the large epitaxial NbN-based junction can be adopted for SSFQ as well as merged-element transmon with the relatively large junctions. The results presented in this work will offer a new choice of the scalable qubits as well as the material platform toward the realization of large-scale superconducting quantum computers.

Here, we investigate microwave-photon-induced perturbations of EMP transport using a quantum anomalous Hall topological circulator. Pump--probe measurements reveal a strongly frequency-selective response: while microwave irradiation substantially modifies the EMP transmission at several pump frequencies, the transmission remains nearly unchanged at selected frequencies, including 4 and 7 GHz. We further exploit the non-Hermitian mode hybridization of the coupled EMP-resonator system to probe the response near an exceptional point (EP). The pump-induced change in transmission magnitude near the EP is approximately twice that observed away from the EP, demonstrating an enhanced microwave response to perturbations. These results reveal the interplay among chiral EMP transport, microwave-photon-induced perturbations, and non-Hermitian dynamics, and demonstrate the potential of topological circulators as a promising platform for enhanced microwave spectroscopy and sensing.

papers.authors: Alexander B. Shick (1); Alexander V. Andreev (1); Evgenia A. Tereshina-Chitrova (1) (1) Institute of Physics; the Czech Academy of Sciences; Na Slovance 2; CZ-18221 Prague; Czech Republic

papers.method: 自洽 DFT+U(ED) 动态 4f 关联
papers.abstract: The magnetic properties of Sm-based intermetallics are governed by a delicate interplay between localized $4f$ states, exchange interactions, and valence fluctuations, yet the role of dynamical $4f$ correlations remains poorly understood. Here we investigate the electronic structure and magnetic anisotropy of SmCo$_5$ and SmCu$_5$ using self-consistent DFT+$U$(ED), which explicitly treats dynamical fluctuations of the Sm $4f$ shell. We find that SmCo$_5$ exhibits pronounced Sm$^{2+}$--Sm$^{3+}$ valence fluctuations, with the $4f$ ground state dominated by $f^5$ and $f^6$ configurations. The resulting dynamical $4f$ correlations yield near compensation of the Sm spin and orbital moments and provide a quantitative description of the electronic structure, magnetic moments, and large uniaxial magnetic anisotropy of SmCo$_5$. Upon replacing Co with Cu, the balance shifts toward the $f^6$ configuration, with substantial changes in the Sm spin and orbital moments. In SmCu$_5$, this evolution of the $4f$ configuration is accompanied by a pronounced reduction of both the total magnetic moment and magnetic anisotropy. These results demonstrate that dynamical $4f$ valence fluctuations are essential for understanding the contrasting magnetic properties of SmCo$_5$ and SmCu$_5$ and provide a microscopic framework for describing magnetic anisotropy upon Co to Cu substitution in Sm(Co,Cu)$_5$.

papers.authors: Harrison LaBollita; Fabian B. Kugler; Antoine Georges; Cyrus E. Dreyer
papers.institutions: 完整作者见 arXiv；单位以正文署名为准
papers.journal: arXiv:2610.06763（10 月 6 日官方列表）

papers.abstract: RuO$_2$ is a multi-orbital Fermi liquid for which an array of complementary experimental measurements has recently become available, making it a stringent testbed for quantitative many-body electronic structure theory. Using realistic dynamical mean-field calculations, we compute the spectroscopic and transport properties of RuO$_2$ in the paramagnetic state. We identify RuO$_2$ as a moderately correlated Fermi liquid and obtain (semi-)quantitative agreement with experiment for its optical conductivity, electrical resistivity, and thermopower. This broad agreement across complementary observables establishes a ``precision'' many-body description of RuO$_2$ and allows remaining discrepancies to be identified as meaningful tests of the theory. In particular, the calculated electronic thermal resistivity significantly undershoots the experimentally inferred low-temperature thermal resistivity, raising an important puzzle concerning the relative relaxation of charge and heat currents in the Fermi liquid regime. We explore low-temperature electron-phonon scattering as a possible mechanism for resolving this discrepancy, while a fully quantitative description remains an open problem. More broadly, our results demonstrate the power of combining precision DFT+DMFT calculations with complementary experimental probes to build and critically test quantitative descriptions of correlated quantum materials.
papers.conclusion: DFT+DMFT 同时比较 RuO₂ 的光学电导、电阻和热电势，为多轨道费米液体参数给出跨探针约束。但这是顺磁态计算与已有实验的对照，不可代替对应薄膜中交错磁序的直接测量。

papers.abstract: This work presents a comprehensive investigation of the structural, magnetic, and electronic properties of the double perovskite Ba$_2$CoMoO$_6$ (BCMO). Single crystals were grown via floating-zone and Czochralski growth techniques and characterized using a set of complementary methods. X-ray diffraction analysis confirmed that BCMO crystallizes in a face-centered cubic (FCC) structure with space group $Fm\overline{3}m$. Magnetic susceptibility measurements exhibit antiferromagnetic ordering below $T_{\mathrm{N}} = 20.1(1)$~K. A spin-flop transition is observed at 26.5~kOe. Heat capacity measurements and entropy analysis are consistent with a $J_{\mathrm{eff}} = 1/2$ ground state for Co$^{2+}$ ions. X-ray absorption spectroscopy provided insight into the local electronic structure, revealing the spin-orbit and crystal field effects. The cluster-model analysis yields a $g$-factor of 4.36, consistent with a spin-orbit-entangled ground state. Surface photovoltage spectroscopy demonstrates a strong near surface optical response with an onset near 1.5~eV and a pronounced feature at 2.65~eV, consistent with visible range Co--O--Mo transitions in line with related Ba-based double perovskites, highlighting its potential for spintronic and energy conversion applications.
